reason: Imports Claude Code and Codex CLI conversation histories into native DSH sessions, placing them in matching workspaces with an idempotent settings-page workflow.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 的历史对话解析并导入为 DSH 原生会话，支持在设置页查看状态并按工作区整理。
summaries.en: Import Claude Code and Codex CLI conversation histories as native DSH sessions, with an idempotent settings workflow and workspace organization.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code and Codex CLI conversation history from configured local JSONL directories
Parses and cleans imported conversation records
Creates and persists corresponding DSH sessions and workspaces
Provides a settings-page interface and same-origin API for importing and viewing import status
